item.title: 15-Drawer Dressers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units; Sold on Amazon by Enhomee-Direct
item.company: Changzhou Jiaxuan Intelligence Furniture Co., Ltd., of China
item.brand: Changzhou Jiaxuan Intelligence Furniture Co., Ltd., of China
item.summary: This recall involves EnHomee 15-Drawer 51" Dressers. The recalled dressers come in white, brown, and black. The dressers have 15 fabric drawers, and the frames are made of metal. They are 11.8 inches wide, 51.2 inches tall, 39.3 inches long, and weigh 44.8 pounds. Only orders placed on or before April 10, 2026, are part of this recall.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall and place them in an area that children cannot access. Contact EnHomee-Direct for instructions on how to identify affected units and dispose of the dressers to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to submit a photo to enhomeestore@gmail.com demonstrating disposal of the product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
